faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the Senior Research Assistant post at IIM Lucknow is 10 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Senior Research Assistant post in the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow Recruitment 2026. This is a contractual position offering a good opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the name of the post for which IIM Lucknow is recruiting?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive by IIM Lucknow is for the position of Senior Research Assistant. This role requires specific qualifications and experience as detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required qualification for the Senior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post-graduation in Management or related subjects from a reputed institute. A minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience is preferred for this role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Senior Research Assistant post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month, along with HRA. This is a competitive remuneration package.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant vacancies?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Senior Research Assistant posts at IIM Lucknow is online. Interested candidates need to visit the official website or use the direct link to apply.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the IIM Lucknow Senior Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Senior Research Assistant recruitment at IIM Lucknow. Applicants can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Senior Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny of applications and CVs, followed by a personal interview. Successful candidates will then undergo document verification to confirm their eligibility.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job location for the Senior Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The job location for the Senior Research Assistant post is Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. IIM Lucknow is located at Pincode 226013, offering a vibrant academic environment.
